items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Two-game TD drought sans Rice
items.text:
Mahomes completed 19 of 33 passes for 165 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks. He added two rushing attempts for 14 yards.

items.title: Sam Darnold: One TD, one INT in comfortable win
items.text:
Darnold completed 20 of 28 passes for 257 yards, one touchdown and one interception in Sunday's 20-3 win over the Chiefs. He added two rushing attempts for 17 yards.

items.title: Emanuel Wilson: Rumbles for 100 yards, TD
items.text:
Wilson rushed 24 times for 100 yards and a touchdown while catching his lone target for 15 yards in Sunday's 20-3 win over the Chiefs.

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Stymied by Seattle's elite front
items.text:
Walker rushed 14 times for 36 yards while catching four of five targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks.

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Racks up 150 rec yards, TD in Week 7
items.text:
Smith-Njigba caught nine of 12 targets for 150 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for 13 yards in Sunday's 20-3 win over the Chiefs.

items.title: Matthew Stafford: Three-TD day in Week 7 win
items.text:
Stafford completed 23 of 29 passes for 195 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed three times for minus-3 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

items.title: Tre Tucker: Strikes for long TD in loss
items.text:
